subject: Eval window extension request — PO approval pending (HealthSync)
body:
-----Original Message-----
From: Marta Lopez <marta@healthsync.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: brief extension while PO clears

Hi David,

Quick note — procurement is still routing the PO for the pilot. Legal wants one more doc before sign-off and finance has a short queue this week. We’re committed to moving forward with Redwood but the PO approval will likely finish next week.

Can you extend our evaluation window by 10 days (or provide a short sandbox credit) so our engineers don’t lose momentum? We need to finish a demo for the board on 6/30.

I attached the risk assessment we discussed for reference. Let me know what’s possible — we’d prefer a clean extension but temporary credit is fine too.

Thanks,
Marta
Marta Lopez
Head of Platform Integrations
HealthSync
Attachments: HealthSync_Risk_Assessment.pdf

---

On Mon, Jun 21, 2027 at 08:03 David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com> wrote:
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Subject: Fwd: Request: brief extension while PO clears

Marissa / Camila — forwarding Marta’s note. HealthSync’s procurement is delayed; they have a board demo on 6/30.

Ask: 10-day extension or equivalent sandbox credit so they don’t lose evaluation data.

Context: good technical fit; pilot running a small set of inference workflows (chat + embeddings). HubSpot shows high product usage last two weeks. Deal HS-2027-044.

Can we do a provisional 10-day extension on hosted trial for them, with the condition that PO is expected within 14 days and Legal signs the SOW? If finance needs a tight guardrail, we could cap token spend or switch to a limited-seat extension.

Quick responses appreciated — Marta is prepping for the board.

Thanks,
David

---

On Mon, Jun 21, 2027 at 09:05 Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com> wrote:
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: brief extension while PO clears

Thanks for flagging. I reviewed the account and usage — they’re within typical trial behavior and the board demo is a good retention event.

I’ll approve a provisional 10-day extension on hosted Eval (no cost to HealthSync) subject to the following simple guardrails:
- Extension period: 2027-06-21 to 2027-07-01 (10 calendar days)
- Spend cap: $2,500 during extension window (we’ll monitor)
- Legal: SOW signed within 14 days of extension start or extension is revoked
- Finance: procurement contact to confirm PO routing; if PO falls through we’ll discuss short-term invoice credit

Camila: please set the trial expiry to 2027-07-01 on the tenant and enable spending alerts at $1,500 and $2,500. Put a note on the account (HS-2027-044) with the guardrails. I’m copying David to confirm we’ll communicate this to Marta.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

---

On Thu, Jun 24, 2027 at 16:05 David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com> wrote:
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Marta Lopez <marta@healthsync.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Eval window extension request — PO approval pending (HealthSync)

Hi Marta — great to hear from you and thanks for the risk assessment.

We’ve put a provisional 10-day extension in place for HealthSync so your engineers can keep working uninterrupted. Details:
- Extension: 2027-06-21 through 2027-07-01 (inclusive)
- Spend cap: $2,500 during extension window
- Alerts: automated at $1,500 and $2,500 (Camila set these)
- Condition: Legal signs SOW or procurement confirms PO within 14 days of the extension start; otherwise we’ll pause and follow up.

We also attached a copy of the standard Eval terms we use for these short extensions. If your procurement team wants a slightly different wording in the SOW, loop Legal and I’ll make sure our contracts team prioritizes the change.

Next steps:
1) Procurement: confirm PO routing ETA (reply to this thread)
2) You: confirm the demo date remains 6/30 and whether you need a production-scale test environment for the board demo
3) We’ll monitor usage and reach out if the spend cap is hit early

Happy to jump on a 15-min call if that helps speed sign-off.

Best,
David Kim
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachments: Redwood_Eval_Terms_v1.docx
